newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Soprea to launch bid for Santana Motor.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Soprea to launch bid for Santana Motor.

text.p: Soprea, the Spanish firm which promotes the economic development of the southern region of Andalusia, will propose to buy the remaining 16.26 percent of Santana Motor for 30 pesetas per share, Spanish stock market watchdog CNMV said on Friday.
In a statement, the CNMV said Andalusia's Development Institute, which controls Soprea, would discuss the proposal to purchase the 1.18 million shares next Monday.
Soprea already controls 83.74 percent of Santana.
On Thursday, the CNMV suspended trade in Santana, which is not traded electronically but on the open outcry system.
